entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Network slice identifier comprised of Slice/Service Type (SST) and optional Slice Differentiator (SD). Identifies a network slice within a PLMN or SNPN.

entities.name: NSSAI
entities.description: A set of one or more S-NSSAIs. Includes subscribed S-NSSAIs and various rejected NSSAI types.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI for current PLMN/SNPN
entities.description: NSSAI containing S-NSSAIs rejected for the entire registered PLMN or SNPN. Applicable when registration area contains only TAIs from the registered PLMN.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI for current registration area
entities.description: NSSAI containing S-NSSAIs rejected for the current registration area. Managed per access type independently.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI for failed/revoked NSSAA
entities.description: NSSAI containing S-NSSAIs that failed network slice-specific authentication and authorization or had authorization revoked. Applicable for entire registered PLMN/SNPN.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI for maximum UEs reached
entities.description: NSSAI containing S-NSSAIs rejected due to maximum number of UEs reached. Applicable for entire registered PLMN/SNPN and specific access type.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: NSSAI containing S-NSSAIs that are allowed for the UE. Managed per access type independently and applicable for registration area.

entities.name: Pending NSSAI
entities.description: NSSAI containing S-NSSAIs for which network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure is ongoing. Managed regardless of access type.

entities.name: Configured NSSAI
entities.description: NSSAI configured by serving PLMN/SNPN or HPLMN/credential holder. Includes default configured NSSAI for PLMNs/SNPNs without configured or allowed NSSAI.

entities.name: Network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: Authentication and authorization procedure for network slices. Moves S-NSSAIs from pending NSSAI to allowed or rejected NSSAI based on outcome.

entities.name: Timer T3526
entities.description: Timer associated with S-NSSAIs in rejected NSSAI for maximum UEs reached. UE may remove S-NSSAIs when timer expires.

entities.name: AMF
entities.description: Access and Mobility Management Function. Manages NSSAI allocation, sends allowed/rejected NSSAI to UE, and initiates network slice-specific authentication and authorization.

relations.description: NSSAI contains one or more S-NSSAIs
Network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure involves S-NSSAIs in pending NSSAI
Successful network slice-specific authentication and authorization moves S-NSSAIs to allowed NSSAI
Failed network slice-specific authentication and authorization moves S-NSSAIs to rejected NSSAI for failed/revoked NSSAA
AMF sends updated allowed NSSAI to UE over same access type
AMF sends rejected NSSAI for maximum UEs reached when S-NSSAIs indicate maximum UE limit reached
Reception of rejected NSSAI for maximum UEs reached starts timer T3526 for associated S-NSSAIs
Expiry of timer T3526 allows UE to remove S-NSSAIs from rejected NSSAI for maximum UEs reached
AMF can initiate network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure based on local policy
